subject.title: refactor(meeting-bot): extract browser meeting-bot core behind MeetingPlatformAdapter

question: Should `openclaw/plugin-sdk/meeting-runtime` become a public stable SDK now with the proposed 81-export surface, or remain narrower or internal until the Teams adapter proves the reusable contract?
rationale: The implementation may be technically sound while still creating a large permanent compatibility commitment; repository policy cannot choose that API direction without owner intent.

options.title: Narrow and prove first
options.body: Approve the architecture but reduce or defer public exports, add live Google Meet proof, and use the Teams adapter to validate the stable contract before merge.

options.title: Accept full public contract
options.body: Merge the proposed barrel as an intentional stable plugin API after documenting compatibility ownership and adding live regression proof.

options.title: Keep runtime internal
options.body: Continue the extraction without a public SDK entrypoint until a second meeting plugin requires the shared surface.

recommendation.title: Narrow and prove first
recommendation.body: Approve the architecture but reduce or defer public exports, add live Google Meet proof, and use the Teams adapter to validate the stable contract before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This person carried the merged consolidation sequence and is the strongest available history owner for the meeting-runtime boundary.
